description: Open the AI PPT editing WebUI for previously generated SenseNova HTML slides. Use when the user asks to preview, inspect, edit, or open an existing/generated PPT deck in the WebUI/workbench without regenerating slides. Accepts an explicit deck_dir or auto-detects the newest local ppt_decks entry containing HTML pages. Does not run style/outline/page-html/export generation.
